description: Headscale is a self-hosted, open-source implementation of the Tailscale coordination server — run your own control plane for a Tailscale-compatible mesh VPN instead of relying on Tailscale's hosted service (see the Tailscale template in this list for the client).
name: headscale
note: You must create a config.yaml in the config volume before first start — see the official quickstart. The image is distroless (no shell); use 'docker exec headscale headscale ...' for user/node management, which still works since headscale itself is the entrypoint binary.
title: Headscale
